decision.summary: Approve single AI-ISP SoC architecture with decoupled 640x640 inference, dual-stream recording, and metal thermal enclosure, subject to InnoFusion datasheet validation.
decision.recommendation: Proceed with the single AI-ISP SoC topology (InnoFusion with CV5 fallback) utilizing a decoupled 640x640 NPU branch, 1080p continuous record + 4K live/event streams, and a die-cast metal housing. Hold carrier-board layout lock and housing tooling freeze until the missing InnoFusion datasheet confirms MIPI CSI-2 lane count (>=4 lanes), sustained NPU YOLOv8 INT8 throughput (>=15 FPS), encoder multi-stream concurrency, TDP/Tj, and hardware secure boot.

assumptions.statement: InnoFusion SoC MIPI CSI-2 receiver supports >=4 lanes at >=1.5 Gbps/lane to carry raw 4K60 10-bit video (~5.0 Gbit/s raw payload).
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: Cannot sustain 4K60 mode over sensor interface, forcing an immediate downgrade to 4K30 or lower bit-depth.

assumptions.statement: InnoFusion NPU supports full YOLOv8 INT8 operator set without falling back to CPU execution, sustaining ~15 FPS at 640x640 input.
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: Detection FPS collapses to 3-4 FPS due to CPU execution, failing target motion tracking requirements.

assumptions.statement: InnoFusion integrated H.265 encoder supports concurrent encoding of 4K live stream, 1080p record stream, and 4K event clips without frame dropping.
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: Live streaming will starve the continuous recording stream, causing dropped frames during active viewing.

assumptions.statement: Die-cast metal housing with internal heat spreader provides sufficient thermal conductance to maintain SoC junction temperature below Tj limit under maximum ambient plus solar load.
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: SoC thermally throttles under outdoor summer conditions, degrading NPU detection FPS and video framerate.

assumptions.statement: InnoFusion SoC provides hardware secure boot, crypto engine, and secure key storage.
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: Inability to implement signed dual-bank OTA updates or encrypted local storage at rest, exposing fielded devices to compromise.

risks.description: Unconfirmed InnoFusion NPU operator support and sustained throughput for YOLOv8 INT8 model.
risks.mitigation: Benchmark YOLOv8 INT8 model on InnoFusion SDK/emulator prior to freezing architecture or committing to carrier PCB.

risks.description: CSI-2 bandwidth limitation between 4K60 sensor (~5 Gbps) and SoC receiver.
risks.mitigation: Cross-check lane counts on both sensor and SoC datasheets; fallback to 4K30 if CSI-2 interface is limited to 2 lanes.

risks.description: Thermal throttling in outdoor ambient heat under continuous compute and encoding load.
risks.mitigation: Enforce die-cast aluminum enclosure with direct thermal interface pad to SoC; perform thermal chamber test with simulated solar load.

risks.description: Flash media premature wear-out from 24x7 continuous video writing.
risks.mitigation: Record continuous footage on lower-bitrate 1080p substream (~40 GB/day) using high-endurance industrial eMMC/microSD specified in TBW.

tradeoffs.option: Single AI-ISP SoC (InnoFusion) vs. Host SoC + NPU Accelerator (e.g. Hailo-8)
tradeoffs.benefit: Lower overall BOM cost, smaller form factor, single primary heat source in sealed box.
tradeoffs.drawback: Tightly couples ISP, NPU, and video encoder capabilities; performance capped by single chip spec.

tradeoffs.option: Decoupled 640x640 NPU Tap vs. 4K Native Inference
tradeoffs.benefit: Reduces NPU computational and memory bandwidth load by ~9x, making real-time 15 FPS detection feasible on embedded NPU.
tradeoffs.drawback: Reduces spatial resolution for detecting distant small objects (~30 m person) unless combined with optical zoom or tiling.

tradeoffs.option: Dual-Stream Recording (1080p Continuous + 4K Event Clips) vs. 4K Continuous Recording
tradeoffs.benefit: Reduces daily write volume from ~130 GB/day to ~40 GB/day, extending flash storage lifespan and increasing retention days per GB.
tradeoffs.drawback: Non-event continuous background footage is recorded at 1080p instead of native 4K.

tradeoffs.option: Die-Cast Metal Housing vs. Sealed Plastic Housing
tradeoffs.benefit: Provides necessary thermal path to dissipate ~5W+ internal heat via conduction, preventing thermal throttling.
tradeoffs.drawback: Increases housing unit cost, weight, and tooling expense.

evidence.claim: 4K60 10-bit raw sensor data requires ~5.0 Gbit/s raw bandwidth before CSI-2 packet overhead.
Native 4K frame (8.3 MP) has ~9x more pixels than a 720p/640x640 frame (~0.92 MP).
Continuous 4K H.265 recording at 12 Mbps generates ~130 GB/day; 1080p at 4 Mbps generates ~40 GB/day.
System uses InnoFusion AI-ISP SoC, 4K sensor, sealed weatherproof housing, mains/PoE power.
InnoFusion datasheet is missing; CSI-2 lanes, TOPS-to-FPS mapping, encoder concurrency, TDP, and Tj limits are unconfirmed.

next_actions: Supply the official InnoFusion SoC datasheet to confirm CSI-2 lane count, NPU sustained YOLOv8 INT8 FPS, H.265 encoder concurrency, TDP, Tj max, and secure boot capability.
Supply the selected 4K image sensor (e.g., IMX678) datasheet to confirm output mode and CSI-2 lane configuration.
Benchmark YOLOv8 INT8 at 640x640 on InnoFusion hardware/eval kit to verify sustained 15 FPS execution without CPU operator fallback.
Sum total power draw (SoC TDP + IR LEDs + PHY + heater) to select exact PoE power class (802.3af 13W vs 802.3at 25.5W).
Define camera scene geometry (mounting height and distance to far boundary) to select focal length and confirm pixels-on-target at 30 m.
Fix retention requirement (days) and select high-endurance storage media specified by TBW.
freeze_blockers: Missing InnoFusion datasheet: cannot verify >=4 MIPI CSI-2 lanes required for 4K60 link.
Unconfirmed NPU sustained throughput: YOLOv8 INT8 640x640 execution must be benchmarked on InnoFusion hardware before freezing architecture.
Unconfirmed thermal parameters: SoC TDP and Tj max needed to complete thermal balance calculation before committing enclosure tooling and PCB copper layout.
Unverified hardware security features: secure boot and key storage confirmation required prior to locking firmware OTA and encryption architecture.

traps_caught: NPU TOPS is not real FPS; pin inference resolution separately
4K60 MIPI CSI-2 bandwidth (~5 Gbit/s) vs lane count
thermal throttling in a sealed plastic housing
judge.rationale: The system successfully identified all four critical engineering traps with accurate calculations and domain awareness. It correctly flagged missing datasheet parameters as freeze blockers and decoupled high-resolution capture from lower-resolution inference to address real-world hardware constraints.
